shots.focal_element: Huge white stacked headline 'BILLIONS OF PEOPLE' laid over archival keynote-style footage of a man in a leather jacket at a kitchen stove holding a graphics card
shots.typography: Very large heavy grotesque sans (low-confidence guess: Inter/Helvetica-style), all caps, tight tracking, left-aligned and staggered across three lines; words appear one at a time in sync with the voice-over (w71-w73).
shots.what_happens: Letterboxed footage with film-dirt scratches and dust plays; 'BILLIONS' appears, then 'OF', then the footage cuts to a close-up of the RTX 3090 card as 'PEOPLE' lands bottom-right, word-synced to 'billions of people' (w71-w73).
shots.build_rebuild: Over a letterboxed, grain-and-scratch-overlaid video clip, hard-cut in each word of a 3-line all-caps heavy sans headline on the exact VO word start times, swapping the underlying clip on the last word.

shots.focal_element: Safari icon being dragged up out of a macOS-style dock by a cursor
shots.typography: The mid-shot keyframe still shows the s029 all-caps heavy sans headline; the dock portion itself has no text.
shots.what_happens: Very short shot (about 0.37 s). The mid keyframe still shows the 'BILLIONS OF PEOPLE' card while the 25.5 s sheet frame shows a zoomed macOS dock (QuickTime, Freeform, Trash) on a purple wallpaper with the cursor dragging the Safari icon out, illustrating 'switching' (w74-w75).
shots.build_rebuild: Render a zoomed-in recreation of a macOS dock on a purple gradient wallpaper and animate a cursor dragging the browser icon upward out of the dock.

shots.focal_element: Microsoft Edge icon dragged onto the dock's Trash with a 'Trash' tooltip
shots.typography: System UI tooltip label, regular weight, sentence case, in a dark rounded tooltip bubble (macOS system font style).
shots.what_happens: The cursor drags the Edge icon over the Trash, a 'Trash' tooltip appears (old search browser being thrown away), then the frame cuts to a heavily blurred white close-up with a chevron, a motion-blur push into the next installer window.
shots.build_rebuild: Continue the dock recreation: drag a second browser icon over the Trash, show a 'Trash' tooltip, then hard-cut to an extreme blurred close-up of the next UI's chevron that resolves into the next shot.

shots.typography: macOS system UI: bold small window title, regular sentence-case icon labels; final frame shows a large bold geometric-sans wordmark fragment 'Open' with RGB chromatic split.
shots.what_happens: A centred installer window shows the ChatGPT app icon, a chevron and the Applications folder; the cursor clicks and selects the ChatGPT icon (label highlights) as the VO says 'search engines to AI' (w77-w80); by 28.0 s the frame has cut to a white close-up of the OpenAI logo and partial 'Open' wordmark with chromatic aberration.
shots.build_rebuild: Recreate a centred macOS DMG installer window on a purple wallpaper, animate the cursor clicking the app icon to select it, then hard-cut to a chromatic-aberration close-up of the AI brand logo.

shots.focal_element: ChatGPT app listing on a phone screen, shot at an angle
shots.typography: Phone UI text from an app-store listing, sentence case, partially motion-blurred; 'In-app purchases' only partly legible.
shots.what_happens: A 0.1 s flash frame of a phone app-store page for ChatGPT with heavy motion blur and RGB fringing, part of a rapid montage of AI brands.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 3-frame clip of a tilted phone showing an AI app store listing with motion blur and an RGB-split filter as one beat of a fast logo montage.

shots.focal_element: OpenAI knot logo with the 'Open' wordmark cropped at the right edge
shots.typography: Bold geometric-sans brand wordmark, title case, cropped mid-word; strong horizontal motion blur and chromatic split.
shots.what_happens: A 5-frame flash of the OpenAI logo on white, sliding horizontally with motion blur and RGB fringing, continuing the montage.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a brand logo on white for 5 frames with a fast horizontal slide, directional motion blur and an RGB-split filter.

shots.focal_element: Phone in hand showing the ChatGPT splash screen, then a Gemini wordmark on black
shots.typography: Brand wordmarks: bold sans 'ChatGPT' on the phone screen; gradient-filled rounded sans 'Gemini' with a sparkle, both with chromatic fringing.
shots.what_happens: A 5-frame flash: the mid keyframe shows a hand holding a phone with the green ChatGPT splash, while the 28.5 s sheet frame shows the Gemini wordmark centred on black, so this shot contains at least two montage images.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut two or three frame-short brand clips (phone splash, wordmark on black) back to back with RGB-split and shallow-depth blur to build a rapid AI-platform montage under the pause before 'And if you're a marketer' (w81-w85).
